title: VisionQueue Ground Truth Annotation Schema
description: Minimalist ground truth annotation for real-world video evaluation of the VisionQueue CV subsystem. Supports occupancy, crossing events, and optional trajectory annotation without requiring per-frame bounding boxes. See annotation_protocol field for how to label clips.

video_filename.description: Filename of the annotated video (for reference, not used by evaluator).

source_description.description: Human-readable description of the camera/scene (e.g. 'Queue at campus dining hall', 'Bank teller window').

fps.description: Video FPS used to calculate frame<->timestamp conversion.

total_frames.description: Total number of frames in the annotated clip.

duration_seconds.description: Total duration of the annotated clip in seconds.

scenario_type.description: Dominant scenario type in this clip.

annotated_by.description: Name or identifier of the human annotator.

notes.description: Additional notes about conditions, known issues, or difficult sections.

annotation_protocol.description: Documents the annotation methodology used to produce this ground truth.

track_identity_protocol.description: How the annotator handled re-identification. REQUIRED: must state whether the annotator treats a re-entering person as the same annotation ID or a new one, within this specific clip. Example: 'Annotator used contextual continuity: if a person left and returned within 30 seconds with consistent appearance, they were labelled as the same annotation ID.' Or: 'Annotator created a new ID for every entry event; no cross-entry identity was assumed.'

annotation_sampling_rate.description: For occupancy labels, whether every frame was annotated or sampled (e.g. 'every_frame' or 'every_30_frames').

crossing_tolerance_seconds.description: The temporal matching tolerance in seconds that should be used by the evaluator to match predicted crossing events to ground truth crossing events. Document this value explicitly.

occupancy.description: Per-frame or sampled occupancy ground truth. At minimum, include enough occupancy labels to establish the true peak occupancy and validate count accuracy across the clip.

timestamp_seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds from clip start (for cross-referencing).

person_count.description: Manually counted number of people visible within the counting zone/ROI at this frame. IMPORTANT: This count is for the SAME counting zone that the CV system is configured to evaluate. If evaluating whole-frame, count all visible people. If evaluating ROI, count only people inside the ROI.

confidence.description: Annotator confidence in the person count at this frame.

crossings.description: Entry and exit events as observed by the human annotator. Each crossing is an anonymous event annotation.

frame.description: Frame number when the crossing event occurred (annotator's best estimate).

direction.description: Direction of crossing relative to the virtual line.

annotation_id.description: Anonymous local identifier (e.g. 'P1', 'person_3'). This ID is only meaningful within this annotated clip. It does NOT represent persistent identity across clips or sessions.

notes.description: Optional annotation notes (e.g. 'Occluded during crossing', 'Person re-entered within 20s').

trajectories.description: OPTIONAL per-person trajectory annotations. This is the most burdensome annotation type. Include only for selected dense/occlusion segments. If omitted, trajectory-based tracking metrics will not be evaluated.

annotation_id.description: Local anonymous person identifier (e.g. 'P1'). Unique within this clip.

first_frame.description: First frame where this person is visible.

last_frame.description: Last frame where this person is visible.

segment.description: 'FULL' if person was tracked from first to last frame. 'PARTIAL' if the person entered or exited outside the annotated clip boundaries.

waypoints.description: Key frame positions. Sparse annotation: annotate only every N frames or at significant trajectory changes.

bottom_center_x.description: Estimated bottom-center X pixel coordinate of the person.

bottom_center_y.description: Estimated bottom-center Y pixel coordinate of the person.

occluded.description: Whether the person was heavily occluded at this frame (annotator used best estimate).

metrics.description: Globally computed ground truth summary metrics. These are computed from the full annotated clip (occupancy + crossings) and are used to validate the evaluator's own computed totals.

total_entries.description: Total number of ENTRY crossing events in the annotated clip.

total_exits.description: Total number of EXIT crossing events in the annotated clip.

peak_occupancy.description: Maximum concurrent person count observed during the clip (from the occupancy array).

peak_occupancy_frame.description: Frame number at which peak occupancy first occurred.

annotation_id_count.description: Total number of unique annotation IDs in the crossings list. NOTE: This is NOT 'true unique humans' — it is the count of distinct annotation instances within the clip, following the track_identity_protocol defined above. Do NOT confuse this with unique human beings across sessions or cameras.

critical_events.description: Timestamps of challenging visual events to correlate with tracker breakdowns and accuracy degradation.
